searchText: Thanks <@539495253418180618> ! Didn't find any security analysis in the annotated spec though. > light clients have an honest majority assumption of the sync committee Is it `> 2/3` or `>1/2` in this context? Yes, https://github.com/metacraft-labs/DendrETH/tree/main/docs/long-range-syncing You can choose depending on your needs. Depending on the age from where you start syncing, you may want to increase the threshold. Default is a 2/3 supermajority threshold.
